g.text: Frozen CPU calibration is reused without retiming; actual wall times come from the completed confirmation request traces.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #516574

g.text: One request forecasts for all 100 robots. Startup is separate. Every family pays another 0.50 s FIFO delay.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Timing summaries are descriptive maxima and calibration quantiles, not confidence intervals or device benchmarks. Calibration: one CPU thread, three repeated 24-step sequences per arm.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Confirmation maxima use 128 scientific rollouts; eight exact replays also enter the runtime veto. Predictor startup includes initialization/loading outside request charges.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Schematic only: the previously trained model uses simulator future-target supervision and an EMA context teacher, absent at inference. Original-ensemble comparisons cover the entire package.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Direct horizons avoid recursive summation of model corrections; they do not guarantee bounded cumulative packet loss. Simulation only; no physical-car or production qualification.
